description: Indulge in the ultimate comfort food with this classic homemade baked mac and cheese recipe. Featuring tender pasta enveloped in a rich, creamy cheese sauce and topped with a golden, crispy crust, it is perfect for any family meal. This dish brings a warm, nostalgic flavor to your table, satisfying every craving for cheesy goodness.

ingredients.notes: optional, for a hint of spice

instructions.title: Prepare the Pasta
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375F (190C). Cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain well and set aside. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.

instructions.title: Make the Roux
instructions.text: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven over medium heat, melt 3 tablespoons of unsalted butter. Add the all-purpose flour and whisk constantly for 1-2 minutes until a smooth, light golden paste (roux) forms.

instructions.title: Whisk in Milk
instructions.text: Gradually whisk in the warm whole milk, a little at a time, ensuring no lumps form. Continue to whisk until the sauce thickens, about 5-7 minutes. It should be smooth and coats the back of a spoon.

instructions.title: Add the Cheeses and Seasonings
instructions.text: Remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the shredded sharp cheddar cheese, Gruyere cheese, and grated Parmesan cheese until completely melted and smooth. Add the salt, black pepper, dry mustard powder (if using), and cayenne pepper (if using). Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.

instructions.title: Combine Pasta and Sauce
instructions.text: Add the cooked and drained macaroni to the cheese sauce. Stir gently until all the pasta is evenly coated with the rich, creamy sauce.

instructions.title: Assemble and Bake
instructions.text: Pour the macaroni and cheese mixture into the prepared baking dish. In a small bowl, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and toss with the Panko breadcrumbs. Sprinkle the buttered breadcrumbs evenly over the top of the mac and cheese. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until bubbly and the topping is golden brown.

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Remove from the oven and let the mac and cheese rest for 5-10 minutes before serving. This allows the sauce to set slightly, making it easier to serve. Enjoy your homemade baked mac and cheese!

tips: For a truly rich, authentic American mac and cheese, use a combination of sharp cheddar and a good melting cheese like Gruyere or Monterey Jack for complex flavor and superior creaminess.
To prevent a grainy sauce, ensure your milk is warm before adding it to the roux, and add shredded cheese gradually off the heat, stirring until fully melted and smooth.
Mac and cheese is best served fresh from the oven, but leftovers can be reheated gently in the microwave or oven with a splash of milk to restore creaminess.
